about_the_game: Take to the stars in Royal Odyssey, a top-down space shooter inspired by the classic Shoot-Em-Up(Shmup) genre. Pilot Prince Zayven’s ship through a relentless asteroid storm as he races to return home and save his kingdom from a sudden threat. With quick reflexes, strategic upgrades and fast-paced action...can you overcome the dangers of space and complete Zayven's heroic journey before it's too late?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04+ / SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 620 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 710 / AMD Radeon R5 240
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA-compatible sound card
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ / SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 550
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA-compatible sound card

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620 / GeForce GT 710 / Radeon R5 240

  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card or onboard audio
  • Additional Notes: Stereo speakers or headphones recommended

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

short_description: Royal Odyssey is a fast-paced, top-down space shooter inspired by classic Shmups. Pilot Prince Zayven’s ship through a deadly asteroid field, upgrade your ship, and navigate the dangers of space to complete his heroic mission.
